description: List every region, category, funding stage and platform that currently has listings, with counts. Call this before the first search of a conversation, and whenever a filter value is in doubt. The vocabularies are closed and curated — a region or category that is not on this list matches nothing, and an empty result from a guessed filter is indistinguishable from a genuinely empty directory. The counts are also the fastest way to see the shape of the directory: which markets are represented, where the listings actually are, and which filters are worth offering someone. Takes no arguments and is cheap. There is no reason to avoid calling it.
name: list_filters
title: List available filters
